title: Looking Back At Old Relationships With New Eyes - Inner Work

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间以外的钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的额外专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森百货的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“内在工作”。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的到来。

sentences.en: I had a really wonderful time recording the main podcast episode with Dr. Kate Sherratt.
sentences.zh: 我和凯特·谢拉特博士录制的那期主播客节目非常愉快。

sentences.en: I think it is such a strong episode.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是一期非常有力的节目。

sentences.en: And if you've listened to it or watched it, I would love your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过或看过它，我很想听听你的想法。

sentences.en: What really struck me afterwards is just how amazing it can be for us to reflect and to grow and then to kind of think about these relational patterns and think about setting ourselves up for things to go really well in future.
sentences.zh: 事后真正触动我的是，反思、成长，然后思考这些关系模式，并为未来做好准备，这对我们来说是多么神奇的事情。

sentences.en: And then that obviously impacts on our future friendships, our future work dynamics, our future relationships, if you go on to have new relationships.
sentences.zh: 这显然会影响我们未来的友谊、工作动态，以及如果你继续开启新关系的话，未来的恋爱关系。

sentences.en: But then, you know, we might kind of almost look back on our previous experiences, maybe with some difficult feelings,
sentences.zh: 但你知道，我们有时几乎会回顾过去的经历，或许带着一些复杂的情绪，

sentences.en: maybe with some grief for what we feel we might have missed out on or what others might have missed out on.
sentences.zh: 或许带着对我们认为可能错过的东西，或者别人可能错过的东西的遗憾。

sentences.en: Or what could have been different if we had been aware of our own relational patterns earlier on?
sentences.zh: 或者，如果我们早点意识到自己的关系模式，事情会有什么不同？

sentences.en: Maybe you realised that someone you'd previously spent time with was actually a better fit for you than you thought.
sentences.zh: 也许你意识到，你以前花时间相处的人实际上比你想象的更适合你。

sentences.en: Maybe you thought maybe you had discounted them as being boring or maybe the decisions you made reflected the person you were at that time and the priorities, the values,
sentences.zh: 也许你曾认为他们很无聊，或者你所做的决定反映了当时的你，以及当时的优先事项、价值观，

sentences.en: the things that were important to you then.
sentences.zh: 以及那时对你来说重要的事情。

sentences.en: But as you age, as you mature, as you change, as you develop and as you have new experiences, new encounters, ones that you like and ones you didn't so much, you will change.
sentences.zh: 但随着年龄增长、心智成熟、不断改变、不断发展，以及经历新的遭遇——无论你喜欢还是不喜欢——你都会改变。

sentences.en: I do think we should all be malleable always.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为我们应该始终保持可塑性。

sentences.en: We should always be reflecting, to be growing, to be curious.
sentences.zh: 我们应该始终反思、成长、保持好奇心。

sentences.en: And you might just find that if you are making decisions now, you would make different decisions based on your current values, your current priorities.
sentences.zh: 你可能会发现，如果你现在做决定，你会根据当前的价值观和优先事项做出不同的选择。

sentences.en: Hindsight can really feel like 2020 vision, as they say.
sentences.zh: 正如人们所说，事后诸葛亮往往能看得一清二楚。

sentences.en: And whilst we can't go back and change things or fix things all of the time, I mean, you might choose to.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们不能总是回到过去改变或修复事情，但我的意思是，你或许可以选择这样做。

sentences.en: If you do, come and let me know how you get on.
sentences.zh: 如果你这样做了，请告诉我你的进展。

sentences.en: You can also give compassion, send compassion, there's a bit of a compassionate flow, to your younger self.
sentences.zh: 你也可以给予自己同情，传递同情，让这种慈悲的流动，流向年轻时的自己。

sentences.en: For the choices they made, and they did make them with the information they had at the time.
sentences.zh: 为了他们所做的选择，毕竟他们是在当时掌握信息的情况下做出的决定。

sentences.en: I always think it's really interesting when you look back at old photos of people who are no longer with us.
sentences.zh: 我总觉得，当你回顾那些已经离开我们的人的老照片时，这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, what would I have liked to have said to them?
sentences.zh: 你会想，哦，我当时想对他们说什么呢？

sentences.en: Or could I have warned them in some way?
sentences.zh: 或者我能以某种方式提醒他们吗？

sentences.en: And it feels almost voyeuristic looking back on photos of kind of days gone by, people gone by, relationships gone by.
sentences.zh: 回顾那些逝去的日子、逝去的人、逝去的关系的照片，感觉几乎像是在窥视。

sentences.en: And I don't know if you guys have watched the video I did about Lily Allen, even listening to more recent episodes of her and Makita's podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们是否看过我关于莉莉·艾伦的视频，甚至听过她和马基塔最近的播客。

sentences.en: I'm still way behind, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我还是落后很多。

sentences.en: So I think I'm still in 2024, maybe 2025 now.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能还停留在2024年，也许现在是2025年了。

sentences.en: But yeah, like hearing about some of the things that she's talking about, it's like, oh,
sentences.zh: 但听到她谈论的一些事情，感觉就像，哦，

sentences.en: now we have that context for how she's described how things went down in her album West End Girl.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了背景，了解了她在专辑《西区女孩》中描述的事情是如何发生的。

sentences.en: Some of what she's talking about on the podcast sort of feels like it makes more sense because we have that context.
sentences.zh: 她在播客中谈论的一些内容似乎更有意义了，因为我们有了那个背景。

sentences.en: Or at least we think we have that context.
sentences.zh: 或者至少我们认为我们有了那个背景。

sentences.en: We don't always have all the information, do we?
sentences.zh: 我们并不总是掌握所有信息，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it can feel a little bit like we're doing that with our own life when we look back on even videos in your phone.
sentences.zh: 是的，当我们回顾手机里的视频时，感觉就像在审视自己的生活一样。

sentences.en: It can be a really nice trip down memory lane, but can also be really emotional as well.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一次非常美好的怀旧之旅，但也可能非常感人。

sentences.en: I remember after my dad died, I found it really, really hard to look at photos of him.
sentences.zh: 我记得父亲去世后，我发现看他的照片真的非常非常困难。

sentences.en: And my iPhone will kind of automatically store people's faces.
sentences.zh: 我的iPhone会自动存储人脸。

sentences.en: If you've got an iPhone, yours will do that too.
sentences.zh: 如果你有iPhone，你的手机也会这样做。

sentences.en: And then you can click to watch a movie, watch a video of that person.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以点击观看电影，观看那个人的视频。

sentences.en: And when I was really hurting, I used to kind of make myself watch that video so that it began to knock those edges, knock those barbs off.
sentences.zh: 当我感到非常痛苦时，我过去常强迫自己看那个视频，以便开始磨平那些棱角，消除那些刺痛。

sentences.en: And so that I began to then see the joy in those photos again, which had been previously difficult.
sentences.zh: 这样我就能开始再次看到照片中的快乐，而这在之前是很困难的。

sentences.en: Looking at someone that you love, who's smiling, who's very much alive, or looking at photos of you and an ex-partner smiling can feel really complicated.
sentences.zh: 看着你爱的人微笑，看着他们充满活力，或者看着你和前任微笑的照片，感觉真的很复杂。

sentences.en: But if we're just seeing the sadness, then we don't necessarily get the joy or the fond reflection.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们只看到悲伤，那么我们就不一定能感受到快乐或美好的回忆。

sentences.en: And what we want when we're able to look back on relationships, either people that are still with us or those who are no longer alive,
sentences.zh: 当我们能够回顾关系时，无论是那些仍然陪伴我们的人，还是那些已经不在人世的人，我们想要的，

sentences.en: is we want to be able to look back kind of just with the appropriate grief, a little bit of sadness, but not have it be so jagged that we're tripping over it all the time.
sentences.zh: 是能够带着适当的哀悼和一点点悲伤去回顾，而不是让它变得如此尖锐，以至于我们总是被它绊倒。

sentences.en: So if you notice that you really can't look at photos or can't kind of connect to fond memories of times gone by,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你发现自己真的无法看照片，或者无法与过去的快乐回忆建立联系，

sentences.en: that can be an indication that maybe getting things talked through, worked through, maybe using something like EMDR can help things to lay flat and to level up a bit for you.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个迹象，表明通过谈话、处理，或许使用像EMDR（眼动脱敏再加工）这样的方法，可以帮助事情平复下来，让你提升到一个新的水平。

sentences.en: It's kind of related to what I was talking about, but it felt important.
sentences.zh: 这和我刚才谈论的内容有关，但我觉得这很重要。

sentences.en: It felt like that might be helpful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能会有帮助。

sentences.en: If you haven't had therapy or if you think you might be ready for a next chapter of therapy, please do bear me in mind as well.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有接受过治疗，或者如果你认为自己准备好进入下一个治疗阶段，请务必考虑我。

sentences.en: I do offer one-to-one therapy, which happens midweek, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursday mornings usually.
sentences.zh: 我提供一对一的治疗，通常在周中，即周二、周三和周四上午进行。

sentences.en: Thank you again for being a member of Inner Work.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你成为“内在工作”的一员。

sentences.en: I love that you're here.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你在这里。

sentences.en: Please do let me know your comments, your feedback, and I will be back along for the next episode next week.
sentences.zh: 请务必告诉我你的评论和反馈，我会在下周的下一集节目中回来。

sentences.en: Thanks again.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。
